title: 第一卷 第5章 饶恕叶琉璃这一次第一卷 第6章 前线告急需叶家十万大军
lines: “如果混沌乾坤坠能合二为一，将可彻底根除黑暗动乱的源头，还万域一个太平盛世！”
“只可惜，原本属于我的另一半乾坤坠，如今肯定落入了沐云熙的手中，现在想要拿回，根本不可能……”
叶无尘以神念探知玉坠，发现玉坠的混沌之力早已被封印，唯有自己达到一定修为后，才能进行解封。
罢了，如今我只是一个刚刚新生的婴儿，想那太平盛世干什么。
还是先管好当下吧！
叶无尘自嘲一笑，看着在简陋茅屋中欢声笑语的亲人们，倒也觉得温馨融洽。
与镇北侯府比起来，娘家人显得有人情味多了。
甚至对他已是到了万分宠溺的地步，连叶家的传世之宝都拿出来当做赐福礼！
想来在这青州之地，世人根本不明白混沌乾坤坠意味着什么！
只知道它是一件宝贝，却不清楚其中的真正作用。
否则单凭叶家的能力，根本护不住这件玉坠。
镇北侯府这场盛大的婚宴，整夜灯火通明，热闹非凡，直到翌日天明，众宾客才渐渐散去。
万佛殿中，老夫人抱着三岁大的姜牧野，爱不释手，满脸慈祥。
一旁的周氏也是志得意满，她苦等三年，日思夜想，而今终于当上了镇北侯府西院的当家主母！
哼，叶琉璃，纵你是北原城第一美人又如何，镇北侯府西院的正妻又如何！
自己肚子不争气，活该给我周某人做嫁衣！
周氏只感觉心情舒爽，浑身都有些飘然起来。
在大殿之中还有另外一人，乃是一名青年男子，身披银甲，英武不凡，正是姜家排行老三的姜文康！
姜文康见母亲对于麒麟孙甚是喜爱，心中也不免骄傲了起来。
我姜文康的孩子，自当天资不凡，傲视群雄，而非一个连灵根都无法继承的废物！
这时，大儿媳出现在了万佛殿，冲老夫人行礼道：“母亲大人，昨日傍晚叶氏生得一子，七斤五两，一切平安！”
“而今乃我镇北侯府大喜的日子，提叶琉璃那晦气妇人干什么？”
老夫人停下了逗弄姜牧野的手，眉头紧促，神情不悦。
大儿媳道：“不管怎么说，尘儿也是我镇北侯府的血脉，咱们是不是应该去探望一二？”
周氏眼中闪过一抹微不可察的阴郁之色，随后站出，故作喜悦道：“琉璃妹妹竟生养了一个大胖小子，实在是双喜临门，可喜可贺，我身为西院主母，理当前去探望妹妹一番！而且我听说了，尘儿天资还算不错！”
“哼？天资？”
老夫人听到“天资”二字只觉得可笑，嗤之以鼻道：“区区三品灵根而已，在我镇北侯府的后代中，只能算末流，难堪大用！”
周氏再次站出来推波助澜道：“虽是三品灵根，但据说，此子天生聪慧，未来成就必然不凡！”
老夫人每每听到叶无尘的消息，心里面便阵阵厌恶。
因为叶无尘越是不凡，越证明她当初的决定是错的！
所以他必须平庸，必须将其贬低得一文不值。
“仅仅一点小聪明而已，没有强大的天赋，在这弱肉强食的修行界，只是草根瓦砾，朝不保夕。”
老夫人再次冷笑，随后看向姜牧野的目光却变得柔和无比，喜爱至极道：“而我孙儿姜牧野，天生麒麟儿，拥有七品灵根，将来成就才是真正的不可限量，叶无尘与之比较，云泥之别，差着十万八千里呢！”
周氏道：“母亲大人，兄弟之间拿来相互比较，恐怕不好吧，尘儿好歹也是牧野的弟弟，情同手足，我怕会影响到以后他们之间的感情。”
“什么兄弟感情？一个区区三品灵根，也妄想与我的麒麟孙称兄道弟？他不配！而且他也不是我姜家的血脉！”
在周氏的添油加醋之下，老夫人对叶无尘已厌恶到了极致。
“母亲，琉璃当初冲撞了您，孩儿给您赔不是了，可不管怎么说，若非三年前琉璃为我去圣山求药，我恐怕早已丢掉了性命，不如先让她住回西院吧，那后山之地湿气阴冷，产妇与孩子长时间居住，恐怕会出问题的。”
姜文康颇有些于心不忍，想替叶琉璃美言两句。
content_en:
"If the Chaos Universe Pendant can be combined into one, the source of darkness and turmoil will be completely eradicated, and a peaceful age will be restored to all realms!"
"It's a pity that the other half of the Qiankun Pendant that originally belonged to me must have fallen into Mu Yunxi's hands. It is impossible to get it back now..."
Ye Wuchen used his spiritual thoughts to detect the jade pendant, and found that the power of chaos in the jade pendant had long been sealed, and he could only unblock it after he reached a certain level of cultivation.
Forget it, now I am just a newborn baby, what do I want to do in the peaceful and prosperous times?
Let’s take care of the present first!
Ye Wuchen laughed to himself and felt warm and harmonious looking at his relatives laughing and chatting in the simple hut.
Compared with the Zhenbei Hou Mansion, my mother's family seems much more humane.
They even doted on him to the point of being extremely doting on him, even taking out the Ye family’s heirloom treasures as blessing gifts!
Come to think of it, in this land of Qingzhou, the world has no idea what the Chaos Universe Pendant means!
I only know that it is a treasure, but I don’t know its true function.
Otherwise, the Ye family's ability alone would not be able to protect this jade pendant.
This grand wedding banquet in Zhenbei Hou Mansion was brightly lit and lively all night long. It was not until dawn the next day that the guests gradually dispersed.
In the Hall of Ten Thousand Buddhas, the old lady hugged three-year-old Jiang Muye, loving him with a kind face.
Mrs. Zhou on the side is also very proud. She has been waiting for three years, thinking day and night, and now she has finally become the mistress of the west courtyard of Zhenbei Hou Mansion!
Hum, Ye Liuli, it doesn’t matter if you are the most beautiful woman in Beiyuan City, or the head wife of the West Courtyard of Zhenbei Hou Mansion!
My stomach is not up to par, and I deserve to be given a wedding dress by someone like me, Zhou!
Ms. Zhou just felt relaxed and her whole body felt a little uplifted.
There is another person in the main hall, a young man wearing silver armor and an extraordinary figure. He is Jiang Wenkang, the third eldest son of the Jiang family!
Jiang Wenkang felt proud when he saw that his mother loved Qilin Sun very much.
My Jiang Wenkang's child has been born with extraordinary talents and stands out from the crowd, instead of being a loser who cannot even inherit his spiritual roots!
At this time, the eldest daughter-in-law appeared in the Hall of Ten Thousand Buddhas, saluted the old lady and said, "Mother, Mrs. Ye gave birth to a son yesterday evening, weighing seven pounds and five taels. Everything is safe!"
"Today is a day of great joy for our Zhenbei Hou Mansion. What are you doing with that unlucky woman Ye Liuli?"
The old lady stopped teasing Jiang Muye, her brows were furrowed and she looked unhappy.
The eldest daughter-in-law said: "In any case, Chen'er is also a bloodline of my Zhenbei Hou Mansion. Should we go and visit him?"
An imperceptible gloomy look flashed in Zhou's eyes, and then she stood up, pretending to be happy and said: "Sister Liuli actually gave birth to a big fat boy. It is really a double happiness. I am very happy to congratulate you. As the mistress of the West Courtyard, I should go and visit my sister! And I heard that Chen'er is quite talented!"
"Huh? Talent?"
When the old lady heard the word "talent", she thought it was ridiculous, and sneered: "It's just a third-grade spiritual root. Among the descendants of my Zhenbei Hou Mansion, I can only be considered a low-ranking person. I am embarrassed to be of great use!"
Zhou stood up again to add fuel to the fire and said: "Although he has a third-grade spiritual root, it is said that this boy is born with intelligence and his future achievements will be extraordinary!"
Every time the old lady heard news about Ye Wuchen, she felt disgusted in her heart.
Because the more extraordinary Ye Wuchen becomes, the more it proves that her original decision was wrong!
So he must be mediocre, must be reduced to nothing.
"It's just a little cleverness, without a strong talent. In this cultivation world where the jungle is strong and the strong eat the strong, it's just grassroots and rubble, and it's precarious."
The old lady sneered again, and then her gaze at Jiang Muye became extremely soft, and she said with great affection: "My grandson Jiang Muye was born as a Qilin, and possesses seventh-grade spiritual roots. His future achievements will be truly limitless. Compared with Ye Wuchen, the difference between Yunni and Yunni is thousands of miles away!"
Zhou said: "Mother, I'm afraid it's not good for brothers to compare each other. After all, Chen'er is also Muye's younger brother, and we share the same love as brothers. I'm afraid it will affect the relationship between them in the future."
"What kind of brotherhood? A person with a mere third-grade spiritual root wants to be a brother to my Qilin grandson? He is not worthy! And he is not a bloodline of my Jiang family!"
Under Zhou's exaggeration, the old lady was disgusted with Ye Wuchen to the extreme.
"Mother, Liuli bumped into you, and I have to apologize to you for the child. But no matter what, if Liuli hadn't gone to the Holy Mountain for me three years ago to seek medicine, I would have lost my life. It's better to let her live back in the west courtyard first. The humidity in the back mountain is cold, and the mother and her child may live for a long time, which may cause problems."
Jiang Wenkang couldn't bear it and wanted to say something nice for Ye Liuli.
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 5 Forgive Ye Liuli this time Volume 1 Chapter 6 The frontline urgently needs Ye family’s 100,000 troops
